newsitem.title: POLAND: ComputerLand sets new issues at PLN 55.
newsitem.headline: ComputerLand sets new issues at PLN 55.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish software firm ComputerLand SA priced its three forthcoming registered-share issues at 55 zlotys per share, the company said in a statement on Friday.
ComputerLand plans three ex-rights share issues for Info-Serwis Ltd, Computer System for Business International SA (CSBI) and ComputerLand Europe Operations SA.
In exchange for the H and I series of shares for Info-Serwis Ltd and CSBI respectively ComputerLand will receive stakes in each of the two companies.
Info-Serwis Ltd will receive 58,163 ComputerLand shares in exchange for 1,200 shares and CSBI will receive 545,762 Computerland shares in exchange for 966,360 shares.
In exchange for the J series of 119,335 shares for ComputerLand Europe Operations SA, Computerland will receive the right to use the company's name and logo.
ComputerLand has said the shares for CSBI would give it a 87 to 100 percent stake in CSBI while the shares for Info-Serwis would give ComputerLand a 100-percent stake.
ComputerLand shares closed flat on the Warsaw bourse on Friday at 55.5 zlotys. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
